issue.body:
I'm importing a textured ply file using the assimp library and a problem with the UV coordinates emerges if the faces aren't next to each other in the UV map. As I went into PlyLoader.cpp I noticed that the mTextureCoords is made to be exactly nNumVertices in size even though the same vertex could have different UV coordinates for different faces, so more entries would be necessary. I confirmed with MeshLab that the model looks well enough so I was wondering if you could help me. Is there a setting I've missed?
When I'm reading the model I get the scene through this line of code:
m_pScene =m_Importer.ReadFile(inputFile, aiProcess_Triangulate | aiProcess_GenNormals);

Perhaps there is some postProcessStep setting I'm missing?

I've attached the whole model as well as a smaller section of it to see the issue more clearly.

This is what my issue looks like
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/77013473/103669097-d2b56700-4f6f-11eb-9af1-09655acb714a.png)

The model looks fine in MeshLab
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/77013473/103674408-a51fec00-4f76-11eb-8f2d-00bf3d2aa295.png)

This is the small version of the model, and I've numbered the vertices but my indices are 1 based, not 0 based as they are in the ply file
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/77013473/103675413-d0efa180-4f77-11eb-83f5-f3f4748fa52c.png)


[model.zip](https://github.com/assimp/assimp/files/5771490/model.zip)
